## Validation and limitations

Three screened development publications were retrieved (**100% relative recall** on that small set). Two report the same early-intervention trial; this is not an independent validation set, and recall was not estimated for unseen studies. A systematic-review reference search screened 48 candidates. The long-term block reduced the base count by **52.2%**; none of its 30 sampled losses was clearly eligible. Category probes also found no relevant records, but the standard-depth probe budget was exhausted before the final term additions, so the expanded blocks retain a documented coverage risk.

The scope assumes a broad meaning of “anxiety-related,” including OCD and PTSD, and does not impose a minimum follow-up duration. Counts use the current PubMed index with the required Entrez-date bound; this does not reconstruct the exact historical state of PubMed on that date. No publication-date (`[dp]`) limit was used.

This draft needs **human PRESS peer review by an information specialist before use**. The automated critic is internal quality assurance, not PRESS peer review.
